title: Citation mention (labels dataset row)
description: One candidate mention of a cited work (task `work`) or author (task `author`) in a citer's page, as written to .cache/mentions/<task>.jsonl. Split files add `text`. See docs/architecture/mentions.md.

id.description: task:witness/locator@offset; stable while the witness is pinned (lock.json sha256)

locator.description: the page marker closing the page

start.description: offset into the page's normalised text (reception.plain)

left.description: up to mentions.WINDOW normalised characters before the mention

right.description: up to mentions.WINDOW normalised characters after the mention

label.description: a cited work id (task work), an author id (task author), `none`, or null (unlabelled)

rule_label.description: the rule's verdict, kept when gold overrides it

split.description: by sha256 of witness/locator: 0 → test, 1 → dev, else train

choices.description: review queues only: the labels a reviewer may give
